stops.note: to promise, to pledge, combined with re- (back)
to promise back, to answer, from re- and spondere
carried into French for answering a question or request
stops.meaning: to answer a question or request

stops.note: settled as the English word for answering or reacting to something
stops.meaning: to answer or react to something

current_meaning: to say something in reply, or to react to something
